syllabus.title: Practice Test-03 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
1. Question Paper Pattern: The question paper will consist of 180 compulsory questions. 
2. Examination Duration: The total duration of the examination will be 180 minutes (3 hours)
3. There is only one correct response for each question.
4. Each correct answer will give 4 marks while 1 Mark will be deducted for a wrong answer. The maximum marks are 720.
